{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABeeo-QQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhH_4kY", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 281, "title": "Compact Graph Library header: place Web microphone toggle beside the existing rightmost Models link", "body": "## Goal

Reduce wasted vertical space above the Graph Library master–detail workspace. Currently the Web microphone control occupies three stacked lines: (1) the ON/OFF switch, (2) a persistent explanation such as “ON · click a field mic to start…” / “OFF · website microphone controls are disabled”, and (3) an expandable “Website access & microphone help” heading. This pushes the graph list and detail pane unnecessarily far down the page.

**Approved header arrangement:**

```
Graph Library            Web microphone [ON/OFF]  ⓘ     Models
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[Graphs list]                         [Selected graph details]
```

The **Models link stays in its existing rightmost position**. Place the Web microphone control directly **to the left of Models**, leaving Graph Library at the left. Do not change the Models link's destination, behavior or placement as the rightmost header item.

## Changes

- Move the existing Web microphone ON/OFF switch into the Graph Library page header, to the **left of the existing rightmost Models link**. Preserve the existing opt-in, toggle state, permission and cancellation behavior.
- Remove the ordinary persistent ON/OFF instructional/status line from the default visible layout. The toggle itself already conveys ON vs OFF; do not display redundant “ON · click…” or “OFF · controls are disabled” text below it.
- Retain a compact **error/action-needed status only when needed**, such as denied/missing website access or no compatible graphs. Keep this accessible to assistive technologies; do not silently hide errors or recovery guidance. Do not introduce a permanent second header row for nominal states.
- Replace the wide always-visible “Website access & microphone help” summary with a **small discoverable info/help control (ⓘ) immediately beside the switch**. The existing help contents may be revealed on explicit interaction using lightweight accessible disclosure/popover behavior; preserve their meaning and the permission explanation without permanently consuming vertical space.
- Preserve the full existing **first-time website permission explanation and explicit consent dialog** on switching ON. Do not request host/mic permissions on simple page load or merely opening help.
- Keep the selected graph master–detail layout introduced by #279 unchanged. This is a compact header cleanup, not another Library redesign.
- On narrow screens, allow the header items to wrap or adapt accessibly without clipping, while keeping Models recognizable as the existing navigation destination (rightmost in desktop header).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Normal Graph Library state shows one compact header with “Graph Library” on the left, then “Web microphone [ON/OFF] ⓘ”, then the **unchanged Models link at the far right**.
- [ ] Nominal ON/OFF instruction text and the full help heading no longer occupy stacked rows above the graph workspace.
- [ ] Help remains available via keyboard/touch/mouse and assistive technology with clear accessible name.
- [ ] Missing permissions, unsupported graph selection and genuine errors remain visible and actionable when they occur.
- [ ] ON/OFF persistence, permission consent, website microphone visibility, session cancellation, site access revocation and existing right-click graph selection behave exactly as before.
- [ ] Graph list/detail panes, Models link and navigation, other pages and graph execution behaviors remain unchanged.
- [ ] Relevant automated Graph Library and MV3 extension tests cover the compact header, consent, error states and responsive/accessibility behavior.

## Scope

Only rearrange and simplify the existing Graph Library header and Web microphone help/status presentation, primarily in `extension/graph-library.html`, `extension/graph-library.css`, `extension/graph-library-page.js` and corresponding tests. **No speculative features, settings, branding, new navigation elements or unrelated changes.**
